headline: Battle Lines Roil Across Contested Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns show the war’s movement concentrated in a handful of battered sectors. Weathered Expanse is the busiest ground, with nine base events in two hours and 45 in the day; its holdings stand at five Colonial, one Warden, and three neutral, while casualties and enlistments are accelerating. Callahan’s Passage has also sharpened, posting eight events in two hours and 28 in 24, with nine Warden bases and one neutral; losses on both sides are rising in the shorter window. Nevish Line has quieted since the previous edition—no event in two hours and three in six—but still records 28 in the day and remains divided six Warden to two Colonial. Stlican Shelf has likewise gone quiet immediately, though 19 daily events leave its eight Colonial and one Warden holdings unsettled. Palantine Berm’s earlier burst has paused at zero events in two hours, despite 33 across the day. Mooring County is a newer concern, with three events in six hours and casualties accelerating on both sides. Elsewhere, the map is largely still.
